event_data.context: Final-review operability review found that resume_latest/pending_assignments only reconstruct assignment-bearing phases correctly. A scope-split hold currently advertises final_review.advance but does not recover the split preview or confirmation identity needed by confirm_split. A review-budget checkpoint falls through to lens-shaped recovery instead of returning the checkpoint decision material and allowed actions. Acceptance: persist and recover the exact scope-split preview/confirmation ID with next_tool=final_review.confirm_split; persist and recover the review-budget checkpoint summary and allowed decision actions; ensure no-assignment hold phases do not advertise lens result schemas or assignments; cover response loss, process restart, idempotent retrieval, and phase transition through the public JSON-RPC surface.
event_data.summary: Make scope-split and review-budget holds durably recoverable with phase-appropriate next actions instead of empty or lens-shaped handoffs.
event_data.title: Recover non-assignment final-review holds after process loss
